state:
**Goal `performance-pass`, Stage 2 (the growth tool).** `bun nv scaling` has three modes in `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts`, with the ramp, the bounds, `EXPECT`, `KINDS` and `AREAS` in its module doc: `--iterations` over `benches/members/`, the ladder runner over `benches/scaling/` (the default), and `--areas [--reviewed]`. `--check` prints each check's closing line. Tests: `tools/nv/test/scaling.test.ts`.

**`bun nv scaling --iterations --check` passes**: 953 flat, 0 grow, 1 unclear, 48 skipped; all of them are listed under *Benches to look at* in `docs/perf/performance-pass.md`, which now has its five sections.

**Ladders:** only `kind run` is measured; any other kind is reported `invalid`, so `--check` fails on it. One ladder exists, `benches/scaling/arrays/sort.nvs` (flat, `expect nlogn`). `benches/scaling/README.md` says what a ladder is. `benches/scaling` is in the root `Cargo.toml` `exclude`.

`bun nv scaling --check` passes with the one ladder; `--areas` fails, 21 of 22 areas without a ladder. `docs/perf/performance-review.md` does not exist yet (Stage 4).

items.text: **`nvs check --count`** — one stderr line with tokens, syntax nodes, resolved names, typed expressions and IR instructions, each read as a length when its phase ends (goal prose Stage 2, *The compiler gets counts of its own*); `run_check` at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:2196`, the `Command::Check` variant at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:986`, and `nvs run --count` prints the same line beside its own at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:3215`. Rule: `rule:testing/bench-counters`.

**The `compile` kind** — the ladder prints a program; the tool writes it under the scratch copy and runs `nvs check --count` and `nvs run`, fitting a slope per phase count. Add `compile` to `MEASURED_KINDS` at `tools/nv/cmd/scaling.ts:118`; `rampAt` is the ramp to reuse.

**The `fmt` and `lsp` kinds** — clock only, under the second-run bound and callgrind; dispatch at `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1707` and `crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs:1723`, the drive shape in `tests/lsp/`.

backlog: The `serve` kind: requests served, per-request counts and peak memory (goal prose Stage 2 table).
Stage 3: a ladder for each of the 21 areas still missing one (`bun nv scaling --areas`).
`core/IO-File/tell` is unclear after callgrind (`docs/perf/performance-pass.md` § *Benches to look at*).
The 46 benches `--iterations` cannot rewrite: their growth belongs to `serve` ladders in Stage 3.
